brief_title: Does Saxagliptin Reduce the Risk of Cardiovascular Events When Used Alone or Added to Other Diabetes Medications
official_title: A Multicentre, Randomised, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Phase IV Trial to Evaluate the Effect of Saxagliptin on the Incidence of Cardiovascular Death, Myocardial Infarction or Ischaemic Stroke in Patients With Type 2 Diabetes

primary_outcomes.measure: Participants With Any Event From the Composite of Cardiovascular Death (CV Death), Non-fatal Myocardial Infarction (MI), or Non-fatal Ischaemic Stroke

brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether saxagliptin can reduce the risk of cardiovascular events when used alone or added to other diabetes medications

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus
* HbA1c ≥6.5%. (based on the last measured and documented laboratory measurement within 6 months)
* High risk for CV events -Established cardiovascular disease and/or multiple risk factors

Exclusion Criteria:

* Current or previous (within 6 months) treatment with DPP4 inhibitors and/or GLP-1 mimetics
* Acute vascular event \<2months prior to randomisation
